note: Remember-me now initialises from sessionApi.getPersistence() === 'local' and setPersistence is called ONLY from the checkbox onChange (new setRememberPref). The mount effect that flipped persistence back to 'session' on every load is gone, so a saved 'local' preference survives reloads.

doLeave(live): on a LIVE match it dispatches window CustomEvent 'egregore:concede' (CONCEDE_EVENT), waits up to 3s for gameover (waitForGameover races MATCH_EXIT_EVENT vs timeout), then releases the seat via a once-only release() guard. Open (not-yet-live) matches still use lobbyApi.cancel. Dialog copy corrected to 'Forfeiting concedes the duel — it is scored as a loss…'. Engine owner's concede move + Board listener are assumed (Game.test.ts concede tests pass).

The 'Opponent' placeholder seat is flagged { placeholder: true }; the avatar effect skips placeholders (no getProfileApi('Opponent')) and now has an alive guard so a late response can't setState after unmount.
Print mode decided in index.tsx (exported isPrintMode/PrintAllCards) and mounts <PrintAllCards/> instead of <App/>; the early return above App's hooks is removed, so hook order is unconditional.

Deleted the dead wallet sign-in path: signIn(), the 'stage' state, busy/label/evm, and now-unused loginErrorText, SIGN_IN_CHAIN, and the connectRobinhoodChain/detectEvmWallet/ROBINHOOD_CHAIN/AuthChain imports. Privy is the only sign-in path; the Remember-me checkbox now disables on privyBusy.

Removed the unreachable <Plaza> canvas branch, the plazaOpen state, and the './Plaza' import. The 'Enter Plaza' button keeps its real behaviour (opens WorkAdventure) with the URL hoisted to the WORKADVENTURE_HQ_URL constant. src/Plaza.tsx itself is not owned by me so it is left in place (now unimported).

Removed the genuinely-dead RulesPage subsystem (RulesPage, RULES_NAV, RULES_SEARCH_INDEX, SECTION_SUMMARY, RuleSection, renderSectionBody, type RulesSectionId) and the imported-but-never-rendered SideRays/Iridescence/PixelTrail. The finding's 'exclusive helpers' list was partly WRONG: LifeOrb/CardTypesGrid/GasFlowViz/FlowNode/FlowArrow/TurnTimeline/ExampleTurn/arrowize/RULES_TOKENS/RULES_FONT/RULES_HEAD are used by the LIVE RulebookPage, so they were kept (and moved into src/screens/Rulebook.tsx). Board.tsx Side/Zone and src/Lightfall.tsx / src/BorderGlow.tsx are other owners' files.

New src/screens/ErrorBoundary.tsx (logs componentStack, recover panel). Root boundary wraps <App/> in index.tsx (variant 'app'); a board boundary (variant 'board', onReset releases the seat / exits solo) wraps <ChainsClient> in MatchSeat and <ClientCtor> in SoloClient, so a board crash tears down the match, not the session.

InstallPrompt now reads/writes the dismissal through the try/catch-wrapped local.get/local.set helpers instead of bare localStorage, so a SecurityError in Safari private mode / in-app browsers no longer throws inside the effect (which, with the new root boundary, would otherwise blank the app).
Lobby poll skips the tick while document.hidden and refreshes immediately on visibilitychange, matching useRankedQueue/useGlobalChat back-off.

Added useFlash(idle, ms) hook (timer in a ref, cleared on re-trigger and unmount) in src/hooks and used it for MatchSeat's copy feedback (replacing the bare setTimeout). The other eight sites named in the finding are in Board.tsx/Boosters.tsx/Settings.tsx (other owners); the shared hook is ready for them to adopt.

Task-4 portion in my files: declared Navigator.share and the 'mmtcg:solo-end' CustomEvent (SoloEndDetail) in vite-env.d.ts; typed the solo-end handlers in App.tsx and SoloClient.tsx; dropped the (navigator as any).share cast. window.ethereum was NOT added to vite-env.d.ts because wallet.ts already declares it (ethereum?: any) and a second differently-typed declaration is a TS merge error — left canonical in wallet.ts. The (G as any).deckCounts / gameover:any / ctx:any casts are in Board.tsx (other owner).

Added role='dialog' + aria-modal + aria-labelledby + an Escape-to-close handler to the two modals I own (SoloSetupModal, ProfileEditModal). A single shared <Modal> primitive with a focus trap + the other ~7 modals (Board WinnerShareModal, Boosters.ModalShell, Masterquest.modalShell, Settings dialogs, DeckWorkspace drawer, SavedDeckLibrary) are in files I don't own / a larger refactor and were not done.

HubCardTile now sets role='button', aria-label ('Add <card> to deck') and aria-disabled when it is an add target, so AT announces it as a button and the +/Enter shortcut is discoverable. The MasterquestPage <g> site is in src/masterquest/ (other owner).
Added 'view-profile' to showMusic so <MenuMusic/> stays mounted (track keeps playing) when opening a player profile from the lobby instead of unmounting and restarting from 0:00.

Low-priority mobile layout. Removing the Plaza canvas (frontend-06) kept the 'Enter Plaza' / 'VS Bot' fixed buttons; the proper fix (a shared <BottomDock> stacking slot so install banner / wallet-link / solo button don't overlap) is a design decision and a larger change than warranted here, so left as-is.

Added useAsyncEffect(effect(alive), deps) hook in src/hooks. DeckWorkspace's mount loader and ProfilePage's three-await loader now run through it and guard every setState with alive(), so a rename / tab switch can no longer overwrite in-progress edits or setState after unmount. ProfilePage's reusable reload/reloadDecks stay for the post-edit path.

Removed PublicProfile's always-empty custom-deck section (deck state, deckGrouped memo, deckValid, and the ~50 lines of grid/"hasn't published a custom deck" markup). Loader keeps only the public profile.
Renamed useStarterDeck -> adoptStarterDeck (and its call site) so eslint-plugin-react-hooks no longer flags a 'hook' called in a callback.

Decomposition started and verified, not fully atomised. Established src/screens/ and src/hooks/. Extracted the whole interactive Rulebook cluster (~850 lines) to src/screens/Rulebook.tsx and lazy-loaded it; converted Boosters and Masterquest to React.lazy; moved useIsMobile to src/hooks (shared). Entry chunk dropped from 584,024 B (165.4 kB gz) to 498,407 B (143.2 kB gz). Settings could not be lazy-loaded because App imports PREFS_EVENT eagerly from it — request filed in review/requests/app.md to move PREFS_EVENT to a lightweight module. The remaining in-file screens (Login, Landing/Hub, Lobby, MatchSeat, DeckWorkspace, Profile, Ranked, Solo) were left in App.tsx: splitting them further requires exporting a large shared-token/helper surface and was out of safe scope for a single pass in a concurrently-edited tree.
